'''Anthony Roberson''' (born February 14, 1983) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. Roberson played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]], and signed with the NBA's [[Memphis Grizzlies]] as an undrafted free agent in 2005.

==Early life==
Roberson was born in [[Saginaw, Michigan]]. He attended [[Saginaw High School]], where he played [[basketball#High school basketball|high school basketball]] for the Saginaw Trojans and was recognized as a ''[[Parade (magazine)|Parade]]'' magazine high school All-American as a senior.  Roberson was recruited by the [[University of Florida]], [[Duke University]], [[Michigan State University]] and the [[University of Michigan]], after averaging 24 points per game as a high school junior.  He ultimately chose to attend Florida.<ref>[https://assets.espn.go.com/recruiting/s/2001/0627/1219541.html Highly rated QB Palko picks Panthers] </ref>

==College career==
Roberson accepted an athletic scholarship to attend the [[University of Florida]] in Gainesville, Florida, where he played for coach [[Billy Donovan]]'s [[Florida Gators men's basketball]] team from 2003 to 2005.  He chose to forgo his final year of NCAA eligibility and left school after his third college season to enter the NBA Draft.

==Professional career==
He declared for the [[2005 NBA draft]] after his junior season, and signed with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] in August 2005, after going undrafted. Throughout the [[2005–06 NBA season]], he split his time between the Grizzlies and the [[Arkansas RimRockers]], the Grizzlies' [[NBA Development League|D-League]] affiliate.

In October 2006 he was signed by the [[Golden State Warriors]] to be evaluated during training camp, and would appear in 20 contests in [[2006–07 NBA season|2006–07]], being waived in early January 2007.<ref>[http://www.rotoworld.com/content/playerpages/playerbreakingnews.asp?sport=NBA&id=1117&line=74326&spln=1 Warriors waive Anthony Roberson] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304001549/http://www.rotoworld.com/content/playerpages/playerbreakingnews.asp?sport=NBA&id=1117&line=74326&spln=1 |date=March 4, 2016 }}</ref>

On December 4, 2006, Roberson scored his NBA career high 21 points against the [[San Antonio Spurs]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Golden State Warriors at San Antonio Spurs Box Score|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/200612040SAS.html|publisher=Basketball Reference|access-date=August 22, 2012|archive-date=December 26, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121226082404/http://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/200612040SAS.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

After failing to find a job in the NBA in 2007–08, Roberson went overseas and spent the season in [[Israel]] (playing for [[Hapoel Jerusalem B.C.|Hapoel Jerusalem]])<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20140313104949/http://www.ligatwinner.com/PlayerPage.asp?PlayerNumber=211&TeamId=59&cYear=2008&lang=en Anthony Roberson|#11-league stats]</ref> and Turkey.<ref>[https://www.tblstat.net/player/869 Roberson's Turkish league stats] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161010163002/http://www.tblstat.net/pd.asp?p=869 |date=October 10, 2016 }}</ref>

In July 2008, Roberson was invited to be part of the [[New York Knicks]]' summer league team and, on July 16, agreed in principle to a 2-year deal with the team.<ref>[http://www.nypost.com/seven/07162008/sports/knicks/roberson_deal_could_be_end_for_marbury_120090.htm Knicks sign guard Roberson, could be end for Marbury] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080911222045/http://www.nypost.com/seven/07162008/sports/knicks/roberson_deal_could_be_end_for_marbury_120090.htm |date=September 11, 2008 }}</ref>

On February 19, 2009, Roberson was traded to the [[Chicago Bulls]] along with center [[Jerome James]] and forward [[Tim Thomas (basketball)|Tim Thomas]] in exchange for guard [[Larry Hughes]].<ref name="Roberson to Bulls">{{cite web
|url = https://www.espn.com/nba/news/story?id=3919012
|title = Sources: Knicks trade for Bulls' Hughes
|work = ESPN.com
|date = February 19, 2009
|access-date = February 19, 2009| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20090221161649/http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/news/story?id=3919012| archive-date= February 21, 2009 | url-status= live}}</ref> On July 20, Roberson was waived by the Bulls.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/chicago/news/story?id%3D4341262 |title=The Chicago Bulls waive guard Anthony Roberson - ESPN Chicago |access-date=July 20, 2009 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140313111545/http://sports.espn.go.com/chicago/news/story?id=4341262 |archive-date=March 13, 2014 }}</ref>

Roberson later played in France<ref>[http://www.sigbasket.fr/page_les_pros.php SIG Basket Strasbourg] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100105164034/http://www.sigbasket.fr/page_les_pros.php |date=January 5, 2010 }} . Retrieved on February 13, 2010.</ref> with [[Strasbourg IG]]. On September 24, 2010, he signed with the [[Los Angeles Lakers]],<ref>[http://espn.go.com/nba/transactions NBA transactions] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160714190737/http://espn.go.com/nba/transactions |date=July 14, 2016 }}</ref> but he was waived before the start of the season.<ref>[https://www.espn.com/los-angeles/nba/news/story?id=5634296 Kobe Bryant could play in London] </ref>

On October 8, 2014, Roberson signed a one-year contract with Cypriot side [[APOEL B.C.|APOEL]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://apoel.com.cy/content/apoel-kalathosfaira-o-nvaer-anthony-roberson-ston-apoel-afieroma-fotografies |publisher=apoel.com.cy |title=Ο ΝΒΑer Anthony Roberson στον ΑΠΟΕΛ! |language=Greek |date=October 8, 2014 |access-date=October 8, 2014 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141010154647/http://apoel.com.cy/content/apoel-kalathosfaira-o-nvaer-anthony-roberson-ston-apoel-afieroma-fotografies |archive-date=October 10, 2014 }}</ref> He won his first trophy with APOEL just after his first official game, helping his team to win the 2014 Cypriot Super Cup by beating [[Apollon Limassol BC|Apollon Limassol]] 74–58, in a match which Roberson was the top scorer with 19 points.

On July 18, 2016, Boulazac signed with the French team [[Boulazac Basket Dordogne]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Anthony Roberson signs with Boulazac|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/france/206783/anthony-roberson-signs-with-boulazac.html|access-date=July 18, 2016|date=July 18, 2016|archive-date=August 20, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160820123709/http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/france/206783/anthony-roberson-signs-with-boulazac.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Personal life==
His cousin, [[Terrance Roberson]], played [[college basketball]] at [[California State University, Fresno|Fresno State]] and appeared in three games for the [[Charlotte Hornets]] in 2000.
